title: Sally K NDE 22261
content: My sister, my best friend and I had been swimming in the river. Our father had told us not to do it, so in order not to get caught, my friend and I decided that we would ride on the hood of my sisters' car to dry off faster. I don't remember falling off the hood, but my friend said she tried to get my sister to stop and she wasn't paying any attention. I was dragged at least a quarter mile down a dirt road. I remember all of the sudden I was sitting on the very top of the car, and I was looking down at myself stuck under the car. I watched myself for a little bit and never saw myself move. I was in no pain at all, as I sat there. The next thing I remember, I was back in my body with the most horrible pain. My sister and my friend were looking at me screaming. I remember waking up on my stomach, but my back from my neck to the backs of my knees were full of rocks. I had no injuries on my stomach at all. How I ever turned over, I have no idea. Her car was very low to the ground. I crawled out from under the car and spent at least four days in the hospital after having surgery to remove the rocks from my back. I didn't tell anyone about what happened for the longest time, as I didn't want anyone to think I was crazy. It's an amazing experience, and I'm no worse for the wear. Thanks for listening.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Accident I'm not certain. I was dragged under a car.
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I felt none of the searing pain.
elements.At what time during the experience were: Total consciousness. I could see everything around me with perfect clarity.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm I was seeing everything so clear. It was as if someone had turned up the colors.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? No God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.After the NDE: change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No After the NDE
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Uncertain I have always had certain gifts as long as I can remember. Such as foreboding right before something happens, but only some of the time can I pinpoint it. I am a little leery of developing it.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: The best part was being separated from my body and experiencing no pain, and the colors around me. The worst part of course was re-connecting and experiencing the pain of the accident.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes But only with my 3 sisters. They were very interested.
